thread:
maria: Starting controlled rollout v2.14.1 across eu-west during 09:00-11:00 change window. Targets: text-gen, embeddings, rerank. 5 steps, 15m between steps.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout initiated  job_id=rl-20260321-91b2  routes=[text-gen,embeddings,rerank]  step=1 weights={v2.14.1:5,v2.14.0:95}
sam: Quick FYI: embeddings.p95 spiked from 160ms -> 420ms at 09:06. Small 5xx bump to 0.5%. Posting SLO panel: https://console.redwood/slo/embeddings?range=15m
lee: Noted. Any correlating node OOMs or GC in infra?
sam: infra metrics look okay. KV-cache miss rate doubled during the spike.
jordan: Ops-bot run short circuit probe?
ops-bot: [suggestion] run_circuit_probe(route=embeddings,duration=2m,traffic=1%), recommended_action=hold_ramp_if_p95_not_recovering
maria: Running probe now and freezing further steps until we confirm.
deploy-bot: [automated] action=hold_rollout  job_id=rl-20260321-91b2  note="hold by maria: embedding p95 spike"
sam: Probe results: single-request probe latency 430ms, backend trace points to attention kernel hot path, see trace: https://traces.redwood/rl-91b2/emb-0906
lee: Can we route embeddings traffic back to v2.14.0 only for eu-west while keeping text-gen and rerank ramps? partial weight adjust?
jordan: Recommend exact rollback on embeddings-route to v2.13.9 (last-known-good for long contexts). I'll prepare the route weight API call. If weight change doesn't converge in 30s we escalate to full release rollback.
maria: Do it. Include audit note.
jordan: curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-weight -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"embeddings","weights":{"v2.14.1":0,"v2.13.9":100}}'  # applied
deploy-bot: [automated] weights_updated  route=embeddings  from={v2.14.1:5} -> to={v2.13.9:100}  job_id=rl-20260321-91b2-weights
sam: Watching SLOs: p95 dropping back to 170ms within two minutes, 5xx to 0.12% :thumbsup:
lee: Dropping a follow-up ticket for runtime perf: ENG-4991  scope=attention-kernel,long-context-embeds
maria: Release notes update: mark embeddings as "paused due to p95 regression, partial rollback to v2.13.9". Continue ramp for other routes once embeddings triage is confirmed.
ops-bot: [automated] thread summary  action=partial_rollback  routes_affected=embeddings  followup=ENG-4991
